title: Suffix address under index dropping
statement: Let $w,b,b',\mathrm{tail}$ be finite bit strings, and let $j$ be a natural number with $j<|b'|$. The bit at index $2|w|+2+j$ of the result of dropping the index from the encoding of the encoding of $w,b$ paired with $b'$ equals the bit at index $4|\langle w,b\rangle|+4+2j$ of the encoding of that nested string paired with $\mathrm{tail}$, where $\langle w,b\rangle$ denotes the encoding of $w$ and $b$. Out-of-range lookups are interpreted as the default bit $0$.
